//: Build-time configuration for the deployed environment.
Pass it with --dart-define-from-file, which Android Studio takes in a run
configuration's 'Additional run args' and the command line takes directly:
Committed deliberately. Claude.md section 47 forbids hard-coding
configuration and forbids committing secrets; an API address is the first
and not the second. Nothing secret belongs in this file.
The scheme must be https. ApiEnvironment refuses cleartext outright in a
release build, and in a debug build only with a second, explicit define.
The host must be what the server sees in the Host header: the request
signature covers @authority, and the server rebuilds it from the header it
received. nginx is configured with proxy_set_header Host $host, so the two
agree. A proxy that rewrote Host would break every signature.
